Going live is simpler than it sounds.

No studio, no lights, no perfect English. Go live from your home, shop, workshop or stall. If you can show a customer your pieces, you can do this.

  1. Prop up your phone

    On a stand or a stack of books. Sit near a window for good light.

  2. Lay out your pieces

    On hangers, on a table, or on a clean bedsheet.

  3. Pick up each piece and talk

    What it is, how it's made, what it costs. Read out questions and answer them. Use whichever language you're comfortable in.

  4. Buyers tap Buy

    That's it. We handle payments, orders and pickup. We'll help you set up before your first show.

LIVE
Don't want to be on camera?

You don't have to be. Point the camera at your hands and your products, and just talk. This is called a faceless show.

Small on purpose.

We're starting with a small group of sellers, each with their own regular show.

Buyers get to know you, set a reminder for your next show, and come back for you.

Who we're looking for

Homegrown brands, women-led businesses, Instagram shops, makers and family businesses. If you've had a stall at your city's favourite exhibition or flea market, we'd love to meet you. Any age, any city.

You make it, design it or pick it

With your own hands, with your team, or straight from the makers.

You have a story to tell

A technique, a region, a family history, or an idea you couldn't let go of.

Customers come back to you

At exhibitions and pop-ups, on Instagram or on your own site.

You can go live regularly

We suggest one show a week to start. More is welcome.

Questions

What's the community?

Brands from your region or around a theme, each selling something different, who share each other's shows, swap tips and help each other grow. We'll introduce you once you're on board.

I sell food. Can I apply?

Yes, if you have an FSSAI licence. Pickles, snacks, spices and other pantry items work well live.

Do I have to show my face?

No. You can keep the camera on your hands and products and just talk. What matters is that buyers can see the piece clearly.

Do I need a studio or special equipment?

No. A phone, a stand or a stack of books, and good light from a window is enough. Your home, shop, warehouse or stall all work.

Is there a fee to apply?

No. Applying is free, and so is the call.

How many sellers are you taking?

We're starting with a small group so we can help each seller properly. More will join every month.

I don't do exhibitions or pop-ups. Can I still apply?

Yes. Instagram shops and small labels with their own site are just as welcome.

Can I go live more than once a week?

Yes. We recommend starting with one show a week. Sellers whose shows do well get more slots over time.

Which language can I speak?

Whichever you sell best in. Hindi, Gujarati, Tamil, Bengali, English or a mix.

How do you make money?

We take a share of what sells on your show. We'll explain the terms on the call, before you commit to anything.

When do I get paid?

We'll walk you through payments on the call, before you commit to anything.

Know a great homegrown brand?

Send this to them. We're looking for makers with a story, and the best ones often come through a friend.
